text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that the existing parking prohibition on the north side of John Perkins Bull Drive, between Stanley Greene Boulevard and Frederick Tisdale Drive, be extended to the easterly limit of the road. The proposed amendment will include the built extension of John Perkins Bull Drive.

North York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the north side of John Perkins Bull Drive, between Stanley Greene Boulevard and Frederick Tisdale Drive to be in effect, between Stanley Greene Boulevard and the easterly limit of John Perkins Bull Drive.
